# Support

For usage questions and troubleshooting, start with the project documentation:

- [Installation](../docs/installation.md)
- [Provider setup](../docs/providers.md)
- [CLI reference](../docs/cli-reference.md)
- [Troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md)
- [Security architecture](../docs/security.md)

For questions that are not covered by the documentation, use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/dyzulk/aacert/discussions).

Open an issue for a reproducible bug or a specific feature request. Before posting, search existing issues and Discussions to avoid duplicates.

When asking for help, include the aacert version, relevant command, sanitized error output, and relevant environment details. Never post credentials, private keys, EAB values, access tokens, or unredacted configuration files.
